name: GPokr Tools
author: takitus
description: Hand summary, bet readout by street, custom bet buttons, quick chat, thrown props and celebrations, and a 3D table.

settings.label: Hand summary
settings.hint: Winner, board, each player's cards and bets by street, after every hand

settings.label: Bets by street
settings.hint: What each player put in on each street, under their seat

settings.label: Custom bet buttons
settings.hint: Multiplier × blind or pot buttons that fill the bet amount

settings.label: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.hint: F fold · C check/call · Shift+1–9 your bet buttons · ↑/↓ or the wheel over Raise: ±1 big blind

settings.label: Nicknames and notes
settings.hint: Hover a seat for its nickname and notes (✎ to edit); nicknames replace handles on the player cards and in the * chat buttons

settings.label: Share hand
settings.hint: "share last hand" and a one-hand "share hand" box in the chat bar; shared hands from others show over their seat

settings.label: Thrown props
settings.hint: Throw a chip, beer, flower and more at a seat; everyone with the tools sees it

settings.label: Celebrations
settings.hint: Confetti, clap, dance, rail slide and river from the 🥳 button, between hands

settings.label: Card style
settings.hint: Four-colour deck (blue diamonds, green clubs) and the card back

settings.label: Table style
settings.hint: Folded players darkened instead of faded, 4px rounded seat corners, even spacing in the player card, and bevels on the frame and buttons

settings.label: 3D table and chips
settings.hint: WebGL felt, rail and chips under the 2D pieces
